senses.gloss: m. (Syr. תרודא = תְּרֵי יָד) spoon (pointed on top and curved at the end; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Cochlear).
units: Naz. VII, 2 (49ᵇ) מלא ת׳ רקב (Y. ed. Krot. תרויד, corr. acc.) a tarvad-full of dust (v. רָקָב); Tosef. Ohol. II, 3; Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵇ bot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:12">Kel. XVII, 12</cite> <he>ת׳ גדול של רופאים</he> the large spoon of the physicians (two handfuls).
Ib. XXX, 2 ת׳ … על השולחן וכ׳ a tarvad which is put on the table is subject to uncleanness, if it has a receptacle ever so small; a. fr.—Pl. תַּרְוָודוֹת.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 4:6">Yad. IV, 6</cite> <he>לפי חבתן … עצמות אביו ואמו ת׳</he> in proportion to the esteem in which things are to be held, is their uncleanness; (human bones are declared unclean, whereas the bones of beasts are clean) in order that a man may not make spoons out of the bones of his father or mother.
